parsed.g: Preview the Magento Blank theme for the shop in the Magento Admin panel
P_t: Navigated to Content menu in Magento Admin (step 1)
Navigated to Content > Design > Configuration page (step 2)
R_t: Navigate to Content > Design > Themes page
Locate the Magento Blank theme in the themes list
Click the preview option for the Magento Blank theme
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM shows the admin login page (adminhtml-auth-login), not the Design Configuration or Themes page. The page contains a login form with username and password fields and a 'Sign in' button. This indicates the session has expired or the agent has been logged out, and the browser is now showing the Magento Admin login screen.
C: The agent must re-authenticate (log in) before it can access any admin pages
The agent must navigate to Content > Design > Themes (not Configuration) to find the Magento Blank theme preview option
